verification_report.summary: The proof is correct for the exact product affine G-tropical structure stated. It validly constructs the zero-dimensional affine G-tropical structure on Z, identifies smooth psh generators on Z x Omega, proves the metrizable-factor comparison sheaf is closed under decreasing sequences, and reselects decreasing smooth convex approximants on every fixed smaller product neighbourhood, including the d=0 and polar-fibre cases. The definitions and propositions in the [official CLD arXiv v2](https://arxiv.org/abs/1204.6277v2) match their uses and hypotheses. No critical error or unresolved gap was found.
